.. _ecs_task_definition_terraform:

ecs_task_definition_terraform
=============================

This page provides guidelines and examples for defining AWS ECS task definitions using Terraform for LabCas Workflows.

Overview
--------

ECS task definitions describe how Docker containers should run on ECS. For LabCas Workflows, you typically need to define task definitions for Dask scheduler and worker containers, specifying resources, networking, IAM roles, and environment variables.

Example Task Definition
----------------------

Below is a minimal example of an ECS task definition in Terraform (HCL):

.. code-block:: hcl

   resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "dask_worker" {
     family                   = "dask-worker"
     network_mode             = "awsvpc"
     requires_compatibilities = ["FARGATE"]
     cpu                      = "1024"
     memory                   = "2048"
     execution_role_arn       = aws_iam_role.ecs_task_execution_role.arn
     task_role_arn            = aws_iam_role.ecs_task_role.arn

     container_definitions = jsonencode([
       {
         name      = "dask-worker"
         image     = "<your_ecr_repo>:<tag>"
         cpu       = 1024
         memory    = 2048
         essential = true
         environment = [
           { name = "EXAMPLE_ENV_VAR", value = "value" }
         ]
         logConfiguration = {
           logDriver = "awslogs"
           options = {
             awslogs-group         = "/ecs/dask-worker"
             awslogs-region        = var.aws_region
             awslogs-stream-prefix = "ecs"
           }
         }
       }
     ])
   }

Replace placeholders with your actual values. For more details, see the `Terraform AWS ECS Task Definition documentation <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/ecs_task_definition>`_.

Best Practices
--------------

- Use variables for values like image tags, resource sizes, and environment variables.
- Use IAM roles with least privilege.
- Store sensitive values in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store and reference them in your task definition.
- Use log configuration for troubleshooting.

See also
--------
- :doc:`install`
- `AWS ECS documentation <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definitions.html>`_
